edits.text: Reported oracle-bone examples use 工 for status or occupation, including uses associated with craftspeople; bronze inscriptions include it in an official title. Other oracle-bone and bronze uses are separately reported, and the relationship between these status and craft uses remains unresolved. The cited inscription quotation with an unidentified graph does not establish an additional 工 title use.
